## North campus refit: the close-out report
layout: title
subtitle: Three floors for two tenants, delivered over eleven weekends from August to October. This excerpt covers delivery, cost and what carries into phase two.

## What this part of the report covers
layout: agenda
kicker: Close-out report
subtitle: Pages 12 to 27 of the full report

- Delivery: milestones, install pace and crew hours against the plan
- Cost: where the budget went and which work packages ran over
- The two tenants: what each floor got and how its team took the move
- Lessons and next steps for the phase-two floors in the spring

## What kept the schedule and what nearly broke it
layout: two-col
kicker: Delivery
subtitle: What worked, on the left, and what we would change, on the right
takeaway: Both near-misses came from deliveries, not from work on site

### left
- **Weekend-only work** meant no tenant lost a workday in eleven weekends
- **One site lead** for both tenants kept a single snag list and one set of keys
- Desk spines arrived pre-wired, so each row was live in under two hours
- A Friday note to staff cut desk-clearing time from three hours to one

### right
- **The furniture order** went in two weeks late and slipped the hand-off by four days
- **Lift bookings** clashed with another tenant's move on September 13
- Order furniture at survey sign-off, not after the floor plan is final
- Book the goods lift for the whole install at the start, not weekend by weekend

Notes:
Drawn from the crew debrief on October 30 and the tenant interviews in the week after hand-over.

## Ten work packages finished within 1% of budget
layout: table
kicker: Cost
subtitle: Budget and actual cost by work package, in thousands
takeaway: Power and data ran 18 over; savings on strip-out and furniture covered it

| Work package | Budget | Actual | Variance | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Survey and design | 48 | 46 | -2 | Green |
| Strip-out | 96 | 82 | -14 | Green |
| Power and data | 214 | 232 | 18 | Red |
| Desks and frames | 402 | 393 | -9 | Green |
| Team tables | 88 | 88 | 0 | Green |
| Quiet rooms | 126 | 137 | 11 | Amber |
| Lockers | 54 | 50 | -4 | Green |
| Signage | 22 | 25 | 3 | Amber |
| Project management | 120 | 120 | 0 | Green |
| Contingency | 70 | 61 | -9 | Green |

Notes:
Source: the cost ledger at close, October 31. Status is red past 5% over budget, amber up to 5% over and green at or under.

## Each tenant got the floor it asked for
layout: comparison
kicker: The two tenants
left-heading: Dumbder Nifftlin Paper Co., floors 2 and 3
right-heading: Soap Club, floor 4

### left
- 168 people on two floors, 120 desks and 8 quiet rooms
- Focus rows on the window wall, team neighborhoods in the middle
- Desk booking live from the first Monday after hand-over
- Asked for more lockers; 24 added in the snag list

### right
- 54 people on one floor, 40 desks and a sample kitchen
- Open benches for the product team, two quiet rooms for calls
- A drying-rack wall built from the same frame as the desks
- No open snags at the 30-day review

## Three lessons carry into phase two
layout: bands-3
kicker: Lessons
subtitle: Each lesson has an owner and a change to the phase-two plan
label1: Order early
label2: Book the building
label3: Ask the tenants

### text1
- Place the furniture order at survey sign-off, **six weeks** before install
- Owner: the Cubicle 9 project lead

### text2
- Book the goods lift and loading bay for every install weekend at the start
- Owner: the building manager, with our site lead

### text3
- Run a **15-minute** survey of each tenant team two weeks after hand-over
- Owner: each tenant's facilities lead
